## Checklist

- [ ] Scope matches one feature and its branch name
- [ ] Net LOC within agreed budget (or split explained)
- [ ] Tests ship with the feature
- [ ] Existing tests and lint/type checks pass
- [ ] API contracts and error responses documented
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, raw datasets or generated artifacts committed
- [ ] Loading, empty, invalid, stale and unsupported states handled where relevant
- [ ] Files outside declared ownership boundary not changed without justification
- [ ] A reviewer can run the feature using documented commands
- [ ] PR linked to its issue with a clear verification record
